newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Ocean Lady I loading 49,500 tonnes soymeal. Mary E. loading 31,443 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load soybeans, eight to load soymeal and two for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 578 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on July 17, as well as 312 trucks with soymeal and 89 trucks with vegetable oils including soyoil.
Vessels: At public terminal, Aghia Markella loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 50,050 tonnes soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, no vessel docked.
Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 5,000 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 29 trucks carrying 766 tonnes soybeans arrived on July 17 as well as 20 trucks with 552 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 129 wagons arrived carrying 4,888 tonnes soybeans.
